_readme: [MidAutumnReunion2022 2026-10-15] Reunion Under Moon (Global Mid-Autumn 2022). Re-read on change. OFFICIAL = from the client (luaUiRes[1272]/[1273][10049], dlgshootingsunui, MidAutumn_Config[10049], Server_Key). DERIVED = chosen here because the official server value is not in the client.
_minLevel: OFFICIAL Open_error[102] 'Please upgrade to level 80 first.'
_beastMap: DERIVED: the Illusion Realm instance map is not named in any client file. 12176 = GameMap.dat 2019midaut_new (the unnamed Mid-Autumn doc of the 2022 block next to 12170/12227 MoonPalace). 0,0 = map centre (nearest walkable cell). Private copy per player, 10 minutes.
_beastTypes: Boss index 1..6 = Yayu/Zaochi/Jiuying/Dafeng/Fengxi/Xiushe (OFFICIAL names). Types in Festivals/MidAutumnReunion2022/monsters (DERIVED looks/stats).
_beastsPerDay: OFFICIAL max: the window has 4 beast slots. Which 4 of the 6 = random per player per day (DERIVED).
_beastArrows: DERIVED: Sun-chasing Arrows for the 1st..4th beast of a day = 9 = the 9 Sun Ravens that can be shot.
_beastPoints: DERIVED Reunion Points per beast (KillBossTip shows '%d points').
_beastDrop: OFFICIAL item (Beast Core = pill material 1 of the window, tItemInfo); amount DERIVED.
_sunGroupItems: OFFICIAL: DlgShootingSunUi tRewardItemInfo shown on the suns (group 1..5 = btn_sun4/6/3/2/5). Suns 1-2 = group 1, 3-4 = 2, 5-6 = 3, 7-8 = 4, 9 = 5; sun 10 is 'the first sun' and cannot be shot (SunLongSon).
_sunEssence: OFFICIAL item Sun Raven Essence (RewardTitle 'Shoot Reward: Sun Raven Essences'); amount 2 DERIVED.
_bonus: OFFICIAL range 'Reward: 100 - 500 Reunion Points' when the arrow mark stops in the bonus band; the distribution is DERIVED.
_moon: OFFICIAL: 50 Moon Points per Illusion Compass use, bar max 100 (nEnergyMax), 'increase a bit every 60 minutes', [ChgLimit] daily limit exists. DERIVED: start 50, +10 per hour, 3 compass uses per day.
_nightItems: DERIVED: the night side (Moon Palace: Wu Kang's laurel -> Celestial Twigs 3336641, Moon Hare's medicine -> Hare Herbs 3336642, OFFICIAL materials) is not in this client (its window was re-used by Valentine). Passing the night with the compass gives these.
_refinePoints: DERIVED Reunion Points per refine (ActScoreTip: points come from the Illusion Realm and refining).
_pools: OFFICIAL pools MidAutumn_Config[10049].PreviewReward[1] (3-Material Reward) / [2] (2-Material Reward); weights DERIVED (rare: Immortality Pill 3336639 with the official broadcast, Jade Chariot, +6 Steed Pack). Timed +Stones: 'All the +Stones are time-limited' (7200 min, OFFICIAL).
_stages: OFFICIAL: luaUiRes[1273][10049].Total (1000 ... 100000, every 2000 more) and MidAutumn_Config[10049].Rank.Total.
